resources.string: Show an anonymous count of people listening on the public Natune status map while music plays. Off by default, and you can turn it off at any time.
Natune status is not configured in this build.

While this is on and music is playing, the app sends a random listener ID, the platform, the app version and a playing state about every 15 minutes. It never sends tracks, playlists, searches, account details or any other personal data. The service works out an approximate city and country from the connection, keeps each entry briefly and keeps no history. Cities appear on the public map only when at least three listeners are there. Turning this off stops sending at once and deletes the local listener ID.
